question: How was the way of growing the silicon crystals inside most chips first found?
answer: By accident, in 1916. Jan Czochralski, a Polish chemist working in Berlin, dipped his pen into a crucible of molten tin instead of his inkwell and drew out a thin thread of metal that proved to be a single crystal. Silicon for chips is still pulled that way, in ingots 300 mm across.
move: When an accident produces something strange, study it before cleaning it up.
reference: Tomaszewski, Jan Czochralski: father of the Czochralski method, Journal of Crystal Growth 236, 2002
